items.parse_summary: The what-question asks for the commanded action. Within the passive clause, “going off duty on the Sabbath” modifies “the two divisions,” identifying the command’s recipients rather than their assigned task. The commander is unstated.

features.quote: the two divisions going off duty on the Sabbath
features.required_operations: Attach “going off duty” to “the two divisions” and “on the Sabbath” to that duty transition; retain this group as the subject of “were ... commanded.”
features.reason: The modifier identifies the target divisions and distinguishes them from those coming on duty.

features.quote: What were the two divisions going off duty on the Sabbath commanded to do?
features.required_operations: Interpret the divisions as recipients of the command and performers of the requested action; distinguish going off duty from the action they were commanded to perform.
features.reason: These role distinctions directly express the intended target, and the passive does not require identifying the commander.
